claims: San Patricio, Texas is a city in San Patricio County.
San Patricio, Texas had a 2020 population of 384.
San Patricio, Texas was founded in 1829 as an Irish Catholic colony.
There was a Battle of San Patricio in 1836.
San Patricio, Texas is distinct from the San Patricio Battalion.
The San Patricio Battalion was a group of Irish soldiers who fought for Mexico.
San Patricio, Texas is located on the Nueces River in San Patricio County.
San Patricio, Texas is part of the Corpus Christi metropolitan area.
San Patricio, Texas was established by empresarios James McGloin and John McMullen to settle 200 Irish Catholic families.
San Patricio, Texas was a site of conflict during the Texas Revolution in February 1836.
San Patricio County had a population of 68,755.
The San Patricio Battalion consisted mostly of Irish immigrants who deserted the U.S. Army to fight for Mexico during the Mexican-American War (1846–1848).
The San Patricio Battalion is honored in Mexico for their bravery.
The San Patricio Battalion is known as Los Colorados.
The San Patricio Battalion carried a banner featuring St. Patrick.
San Patricio, New Mexico is a community in Lincoln County.
